app.run:
The app is a static site: Snap! (a fixed, unchanged release) with the Calliope mini library, plus the pages Calliope Campus embeds (`campus.html`, `render.html`). Node.js 18+ is all it needs; there is nothing to install. Start this workspace's own with `node .obeya/app.mjs start` (with run_in_background; it returns once the server answers). It builds `dist/` (`npm run build`; the first build downloads the Snap! release, ~130 MB, into `.cache/`, which `start` copies from the main checkout when that has it), serves it detached on the first free port from 8620, and prints the addresses; they are also in `.obeya/run/app.json` (`url` the server's root, `campus` for campus.html, `host` for the test host). Take them from there, never assume a port. Port 8610 belongs to the owner's main checkout, where Campus' local editor preset looks; use `node .obeya/app.mjs start 8610` only when it is free; otherwise set your URL in the Campus room's editor URLs (debug mode). To show Snap! inside Campus, run Campus from a calliope-campus workspace as its settings say (`node .obeya/app.mjs start` there), switch debug mode on, enable the editor Snap! in a room and create a Snap! program. `node .obeya/app.mjs status` tells whether it still runs.

There is no login and no test data. To show something, open the test host (`host` in app.json, `/dev/host.html`): it embeds campus.html the way Campus does, logs every postMessage on the right, and plays a Calliope mini running the Blocks program ("Gerät verbinden", "Taste A klicken", "Nur lesen an/aus", "Aktiv an/aus"). Snap! opens in German with the start project and the Calliope blocks in the palette; Snap! takes a few seconds to load. `campus.html` on its own is plain Snap! with the library; `render.html` only answers postMessages.

After a change to `bridge/`, `pages/` or `calliope/`, run `npm run build` again and reload the page; the server keeps running and serves the new files. After a change to the block table in `calliope/build-library.js`, run `npm run library` first. A change to `scripts/serve.mjs` needs `node .obeya/app.mjs stop` and `start` again.

Stop it with `node .obeya/app.mjs stop`: it ends the server this workspace started, by PID, and nothing else.
